configuration.skills.description: Automatically install Lynvo agent skills (SKILL.md) for OpenCode, Claude Code, Cline, Cursor, and other AI agents on extension activation.
configuration.language.description: Language for the Lynvo interface. Use 'auto' to follow the VS Code language, or a code matching the available localization (e.g. 'en', 'es'). Display language can also be changed at runtime with 'Lynvo: Switch Language'.
configuration.inCodeEditing.description: When enabled, editing a code-linked task's title, description, checklist, or relations on the board also updates the TODO comment in the linked source file. Disable to keep the board and the code independent.
configuration.completionColumns.descript: Column names (or part of them, matched case-insensitively) that offer the 'remove linked TODO comments' nudge. Tasks in these columns are excluded from the labels usage count.
configuration.progressionColumns.descrip: Column names (or part of them, matched case-insensitively) whose tasks are considered Active / In Progress for the Insights 'In progress' metric.
configuration.activityLog.description: Log each activity type in the Activity history. Set a type to false to stop logging it. Untyped or missing entries stay logged by default.
